name: Ellipsoidal 2:1
description: Most common pressure vessel head. Depth is a quarter of the diameter.

name: Torispherical ASME F&D
description: Flanged and dished. Crown radius = D and knuckle = 6% of D. Economical for low and medium pressure.

name: Torispherical Klöpper
description: Crown radius = D and knuckle = 10% of D. European standard for tanks and vessels.

name: Torispherical Korbbogen
description: Crown radius = 0.8 D and knuckle = 15.4% of D. Deeper and stronger than Klöpper.

name: Hemispherical
description: Half sphere. Highest pressure rating and the deepest draw.

name: Conical
description: Cone for hopper and silo bottoms. Angles above 30° get a knuckle.

name: Flat flanged
description: Flat disc with a formed knuckle and straight flange. For atmospheric tanks.
